intro: Lotwil Veriatus praises you as abler than all of Lotwil's apprentices combined, and wants the next step of the tests. This time the need is three large stone slabs, pieces best found on rock elementals.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Friend, you've already proven more able than all my apprentices combined.

The next parts I need require a little more strength. Large stone slabs can be found on rock elementals if you're careful enough. Their bodies are stronger and larger, and therefore more prone to having pieces large enough for my tests. You can find them further west of here or southeast along the mountains' edges.
Take your time; I'll need a while to test these smaller pieces you brought me.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I'm most pleased, friend. My spells affected the smaller pieces just as I predicted. If this experiment is as successful as I foresee, then the elementals I'll be able to control will put anything summoned prior to this to shame.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Friend, simply amazing! I would have thought it'd take half a dozen tauren to bring all these to me.
